svg.text: Architecture only: slots, spacing, radii and layers. Content is out of scope.

g.text: TITLE SLOT FLEXES (MIN-WIDTH 0) AND WRAPS. HEADER GROWS PAST H1.
BODY WELL INSET S6 FROM CONTAINER. WELL RADIUS R2 = R1 − B − S6 (DERIVED).
TRAIL AND ACTION SLOTS HUG THEIR CONTENT AND NEVER SHRINK.
META SLOT WRAPS BEFORE THE ACTION MOVES.
DO NOT CLIP THE SHADOW: KEEP E1 ABOVE, E2 EACH SIDE, E3 BELOW.
WIDTH W BETWEEN 320 MIN AND 420 MAX. HEIGHT HUGS CONTENT.
ACTION HIT AREA 44 MIN ON TOUCH LAYOUTS (H3 DRAWN).
Axonometric · z gaps not to scale
Scale 0.5:1 · E1 / E2 / E3 from Y, BL, SP
